description: UCI row 141 (age 30, MEDIUM vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 4, horizon 3yr) — global equity etf: all hard rules pass, soft fails ['R3'] (score 85) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Brigitte Fournier is 30 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 33,700 euros (around 2,808 euros per month). They hold 2,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 6,100 euros with a 3-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is moderate-to-conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 4 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 6,100 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
